verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as a general AI coding agent that can fix issues, implement features and submit PRs (including via GitHub Actions). It auto-loads LSPs, which surface code diagnostics, and can run actions automatically under permission rules. None of the four specific tasks in the story is explicitly documented, so support is only implied by its general agent capabilities. missing for 10: explicit docs or hands-on evidence of writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, and updating dependencies, plus independent corroboration of these workflows.
